name: extended defect register X3
status: rule and null counts; exact integer enumeration on the pinned public carrier; a relabelling of stored data, not a law

conventions.face: template face f = 0..19 of the universe runs (face 20 c + f), equal to slow_geometry.source().oriented_faces()
conventions.frame: frame index 0..4 in the order of work/KD/item1.json (kdlib.frames())
conventions.frame_pair: a face is the ordered pair (L, R) of the two frames none of whose seams is an edge of the face, ordered so that (L, R, c, d, e) is an even permutation of (0,1,2,3,4), c, d, e the frames of the three edges of the face in its orientation order. Rotations act on (L, R) by even permutations of the frames; the inversion exchanges L and R.
conventions.class_word: the 20 classes of a carrier, face 0 first
conventions.key: base-6 integer of a class word, face 0 most significant
conventions.canonical_key: minimum over the 60 rows g of tables.rotations of the key of the rotated word w'[g[f]] = w[f]
conventions.chirality: chi(f, g) = tables.chirality[f][g]. Separation 2: +1 if R(f) = L(g), -1 if L(f) = R(g); the shortest dual path from f to g turns left (+1) or right (-1) at its middle face, seen from outside; chi(g, f) = -chi(f, g). Separation 3: +1 if L(f) = L(g), -1 if R(f) = R(g); the path turns left then right (+1) or right then left (-1); chi(g, f) = chi(f, g). Zero at separations 1, 4, 5.
conventions.pair_order: for a conjugate pair (k, 6 - k) with k = 1 or 2 the first face is the face of class k; for (3, 3) the pair is unordered and chi is used at separation 3 only
conventions.mirror: bare mirror image of a shape: classes move with the faces under the inversion of the carrier
conventions.conjugate: every class k replaced by 6 - k on the same faces
conventions.handedness_sums: h3 = sum of chi(f, g) over the unordered pairs of defect faces of a carrier at separation 3; h2 = sum of chi(f, g) over the pairs at separation 2 with class(f) < class(g). Both are rotation invariant. Mirror: h2 -> -h2, h3 -> -h3. Conjugation: h2 -> -h2, h3 -> h3. For one conjugate pair they are the chirality of the pair.
conventions.frame_class: tables.frame_class[f][F]: position of face f relative to frame F. 0, 1, 2: the face has an edge in frame F, on axis 0, 1, 2 of that frame (order of item1.json); 3: L = F; 4: R = F. Four faces per class; the classes are the orbits of the Klein group of the frame.

per_defect: class k (1..5); equivalently triality k mod 3 and weak parity k mod 2
only where one frame F is declared (candidate CF-1): tables.frame_class[f][F]
per_carrier: composition: the sorted multiset of nonzero classes
shape: the id of canonical_key(class word) in the table of the composition (pairs: the type 0..19 = class pair, separation, chirality)
h2, h3: the handedness sums (defined for every composition, no table needed)
rule.pair_from_frame_pairs: first face (a, b), second face (c, d): (b, a) = (c, d): separation 5; a = c: 3, chi +1; b = d: 3, chi -1; b = c: 2, chi +1; a = d: 2, chi -1; all four distinct, e the fifth frame: separation 1 if (a, b, c, d, e) is an odd permutation, 4 if even

{4,4,4}.note: shape i is the conjugate of shape i of {2,2,2}: same multiplicity, separations and mirror partner

{3,4,5}.note: shape i is the conjugate of shape i of {1,2,3}: same multiplicity, separations and mirror partner

representations.statement: every placement space is a permutation module of the rotation group; the cover acts through it; multiplicities of the spinorial 2, 2', 4', 6 are 0 in every space; 3 and 3' occur equally often

spaces.audit region (five faces at port 5) unde: one free orbit: each of the five characters of C5 once

held_region.region: the five faces at one port (audit: port 5)
held_region.group: the five rotations about the port
held_region.representation: regular: each character of C5 once
held_region.against_the_exterior_partner: the five positions are five different pair types: separation 1; 2 with chi +1 and -1; 3 with chi +1 and -1
